trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Closure Threat
trends.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard threatened long-term closure of Strait of Hormuz for US and Israel, with foreign minister vowing retaliation. US crude oil prices hit highest close since June 2022, with 600+ million barrels at risk. This is the most acute geopolitical threat to energy markets and inflation expectations currently.

trends.name: Trump Defense Spending & Tariff Escalation
trends.summary: Trump administration announced $1.5 trillion defense budget request while imposing 100% tariffs on patented drugs and revamping steel/aluminum/copper duties. This signals sustained inflation pressure from both fiscal spending and protectionism, with pharma sector facing direct headwinds.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Valuation Surge to $2 Trillion
trends.summary: SpaceX boosted target IPO valuation above $2 trillion, making it bigger than all but 5 S&P 500 companies. This represents massive capital reallocation into space/defense tech and signals investor appetite for high-growth, government-dependent ventures despite market volatility.

trends.name: Stock Market Correction & Volatility Spike
trends.summary: Charts show widening cracks in stock market with predictions of S&P 500 bottoming by May at 6,000 level. Real-time trading data shows massive short squeezes and 'face-ripping' rallies, indicating extreme positioning and volatility. April gains are uncertain despite historical seasonality.

trends.name: Private Credit Redemption Stress & Systemic Concerns
trends.summary: Blue Owl capped private credit fund redemptions at 5% amid steep redemption requests. Fed's Williams monitoring closely but says no systemic risk. Market repricing is underway in private credit, creating liquidity challenges and raising questions about hidden leverage in financial system.

trends.name: SaaS Sector Selloff & Buying Opportunity
trends.summary: Workday and UiPath experiencing significant selloffs dubbed 'SaaSpocalypse' but analysts see golden opportunities at discounted valuations. UiPath specifically noted buying agentic AI at 40% discount with meaningful ARR growth. Sector rotation creating entry points for long-term positioned investors.

trends.name: Bitcoin Supply Squeeze & Institutional Accumulation
trends.summary: Michael Saylor's MicroStrategy estimated to have purchased 617 BTC in single day, 1.4x daily mined supply. This aggressive accumulation amid price volatility signals institutional confidence and potential supply constraints for Bitcoin. Major macro hedge against currency devaluation and geopolitical risk.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Sector Volatility
trends.summary: Brent crude soared to $141/barrel (highest since 2008 financial crisis) while global oil stockpiles approaching critically disruptive levels. Combined with Iran tensions, energy stocks rallying but facing cyclical headwinds. Oil itself positioned as best hedge against oil-based inflation.

trends.name: Intel Catalyst & Semiconductor Leadership
trends.summary: Intel stock climbing toward next major catalyst amid semiconductor cycle recovery and AI infrastructure demand. TSMC's foundry supremacy still has room to run in AI chip space. Sector seeing leadership battles as capital flows into semiconductor infrastructure plays.

trends.name: Coinbase Stablecoin Regulatory Approval
trends.summary: Coinbase cleared key regulatory hurdle in bid to expand stablecoin business, removing compliance friction. This opens pathway for major crypto infrastructure expansion and signals regulatory environment shift toward crypto legitimacy, positive for institutional adoption.

trends.name: Iran Tech Threat to US Semiconductor Giants
trends.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard threatened attacks on US tech companies including NVIDIA and Apple. This geopolitical escalation creates systemic risk for semiconductor supply chain and major tech companies with reliance on overseas manufacturing and operations.

trends.name: Healthcare System Crisis: Medicare Advantage Cancer Access
trends.summary: Many hospitals refusing Medicare Advantage coverage for cancer patients, described as 'overlooked catastrophe.' This systemic healthcare sector issue may trigger regulatory intervention, insurance company margin compression, and creates political pressure ahead of elections. Negative for UnitedHealth and managed care operators.
